telegram.title: Telegram commands
telegram.offBody: Off. Message an agent by name on the shared Telegram bot and it assigns the task to itself — turn this on once the bot's webhook secret is set in Keys & connections.
telegram.onBody: On. A Telegram message naming an agent (its name, Bengali name or code) assigns that agent a task; a message naming no one goes to Gyani. Approval buttons sent to Telegram work the same as this page's own Approve/Reject.
telegram.secretMissing: Webhook secret not set yet — set it in Keys & connections
